name: Chordr
description: Derives chords and generates playable keys-first or guitar arrangements from chart data and audio analysis.
Derives chord names and shapes from chart data for guitar and piano arrangements — a shared capability other plugins consume rather than duplicating chord logic themselves.

hostRequirements.note: Documentation only — no host code path reads this key (core's /api/plugins allowlist surfaces minHost as min_host, not this block). The two-tier table in README 'Host compatibility' is the source of truth.

analysis.needs: context.load_sibling (backend); plugin CSS and the highway chart getters (frontend); the song:loaded event and window.feedBack.currentSong (chord/lyrics view); Node >= 16.6 on the host for the server chart-analysis callable. None of these has been tied to a core release yet, so this tier is untested against any specific build rather than universally supported.

chartEnrichment.note: Automatic diagram enrichment additionally needs core's chart-transform capability (feedBack#952), added 2026-07-19 — after v0.3.0-alpha.1 (2026-07-03), the only core version tag. No tagged release contains it, so the commit hash is the floor until a release identifies a version.

chart-transform.description: Fills in missing chord diagram templates (placeholder -1 frets) by deriving fret/string shapes and names from chart note data.
